# settings

<!-- Generated by `UPDATE_DOCS=1 cargo test --manifest-path host/Cargo.toml --test docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

The settings page writes these keys to `~/.config/browser-hand/config.toml` (`$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/browser-hand/config.toml` when set; `%LOCALAPPDATA%\browser-hand\config.toml` on Windows). A missing file or key is the default, and an unknown key is dropped. The first column is the key in the file; the second is what the settings page calls it.

## `[input]`

| Key | Settings page | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pace` | Pace | string | `"human"` | `human` or `fast`. Fast keeps the same events without travel time. |
| `typing_speed` | Typing speed | number | `1.0` | 0.25 to 3.0, multiplies the gap between keys. |
| `mouse_speed` | Mouse speed | number | `1.0` | 0.25 to 3.0, multiplies the cursor's travel time. |

## `[sessions]`

| Key | Settings page | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `default_profile` | Default profile | string | `""` | A Chrome profile dir; empty asks. |
| `new_window` | Open a new window | boolean | `true` | Whether a session opens its tab group in a new window. |
| `close_tabs_on_end` | Close tabs when the session ends | boolean | `false` | Whether Claude's tabs close when the session ends. |

## `[sites]`

| Key | Settings page | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `blocked` | Blocked sites | array of string | `[]` | Sites Claude never opens or acts on, as `host/path` patterns. |
| `read_only` | Read-only sites | array of string | `[]` | Sites Claude may read and screenshot but not click, type in or script. |

## `[capture]`

| Key | Settings page | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `screenshot_size` | Screenshot size | string | `"1280x800"` | `1024x640`, `1280x800` or `1568x980`. |
| `screenshot_quality` | Screenshot quality | integer | `80` | JPEG quality, 30 to 100. |
| `gif_folder` | GIF folder | string | `"~/Downloads/browser-hand"` | `~/...` or an absolute path. |
| `save_screenshots` | Save every screenshot | boolean | `false` | Whether every screenshot Claude takes is also saved to a file. |
| `screenshot_folder` | Screenshot folder | string | `""` | Where saved screenshots go: `~/...` or an absolute path; empty uses `gif_folder`. |
| `gif_frame_delay_ms` | GIF frame delay | integer | `700` | 100 to 5000. |

## `[debugger]`

| Key | Settings page | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `detach_after_idle_s` | Detach after idle | integer | `30` | 5 to 600. |

The file's top-level `version` key is 1.
